shared_elements: frontal or profile human/anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
head with elaborate headdress or crown-like top
body with garment/decorated torso rendered in relief
carved low-relief detail on a monolithic slab
justification: Both depict a single large anthropomorphic figure in relief with a distinctive headdress-like top, filling the surface, which is a generic correspondence. A shows a naturalistic profile figure with beard, pleated robe, spear and bow, articulated hands and finely combed hair, while B is a blocky frontal figure whose body is covered with abstract emblems (discs, rosette, spiral motifs) and has no discernible limbs or held objects — the conventions and specific iconography differ entirely.
